onboarding.welcomeBody: CASCADE isn't another audit — it's human rights due diligence (HRDD), day to day. Take a moment to learn more about CASCADE's features and how it equips your teams and company with the tools and real-time data to meet the evolving HRDD and trade integrity requirements in the Americas, EU, Australia, and beyond.
onboarding.welcomeStep1Desc: — check out key features, data, and solutions.

onboarding.congratsBody: Your company is making a real commitment to human rights due diligence (HRDD) — and now you have the tools, data, and solutions to back it up. Your workspace is live! Time to make your Company Profile public so that brand and industry partners can find you.

profile.title: Company Profile
profile.body: Find your Company Profile in the Overview section. Fill in your company, industry, and other basic information, and share more detailed information if you wish, for example, your company's human rights and labor recruitment policies. Your company's Profile Strength meter ticks up as more information is completed. Choose which information is viewable by brand, industry, and other partners in the Member Directory.

dashboard.title: Company Dashboard

workerIssues.scoreFormulaNote: Score (0–10) = Quality (50%) + Speed (50%). Quality is worker-rated remediation (Poor=2.5, Fair=5, Good=7.5, Excellent=10). Speed is a sigmoid of days-to-close (30d ≈ 9.5, 90d = 5.0, 150d ≈ 0.5). Strengths shows the top 5 highest scores; Improvements shows the top 5 lowest.

intro.title: CASCADE Grievance Mechanism
intro.subtitle: Self-Diagnostic
intro.purposeBody: This diagnostic assessment tool provides a clear and practical framework to analyze the structure and effectiveness of current company grievance mechanisms. This self-diagnostic tool can help suppliers and recruitment agencies to pinpoint:

bullets.improvements: Areas requiring improvement and how to best improve them
bullets.progress: How to measure and articulate progress made to date more effectively

expectItems.sections: Complete 9 sections covering the critical components of grievance mechanisms
expectItems.score: Receive your detailed score and personalized recommendations at the end
expectItems.email: Get your results emailed to you for future reference
expectItems.save: Your progress is saved in your browser — you can pause and resume anytime

intro.scoreNote: Your final score appears as a percentage and a 1–5 star rating, with section-level insights and tailored recommendations. Some questions are marked as "Challenge" questions and are worth double points.
intro.resumeBanner: You have saved progress. Continue where you left off?
intro.note: The grievance mechanism self-diagnostic is a free tool available to all suppliers and recruitment agencies on the CASCADE platform. It can be taken up to 4 times per year in order to help companies track their improvement.

components.title: The 9 Critical Components
components.subtitle: of Trusted, Effective Worker Engagement Mechanisms
components.noteBody: The assessment contains some "challenge questions" as double points. Take your time and answer honestly to get the most accurate results and recommendations.

cards.empowerment: Detailed empowerment and education for workers

sectionComplete.title: Section {{section}} Complete!
sectionComplete.promptLast: All sections complete. Ready to see your results?
sectionComplete.halfwayBody: Excellent momentum! You've completed 4 of 9 sections. Keep going — the second half builds on the strong foundation you've already created.

results.personalized: Here are your results and personalized recommendations
results.rememberBody: The main point is not what the final score is - rather, it is about identifying the areas and priorities you want to strengthen and raise. The scoring and insights from this self-diagnostic should be taken in consideration alongside worker feedback regarding the effectiveness of your grievance mechanism.
results.recommendedBody: Based on your assessment results, we recommend the following courses and activities to help improve your company's grievance mechanisms:
results.nextStepsBody: Explore these recommended courses on the CASCADE platform to start improving your grievance mechanisms. You can retake this assessment up to 4 times per year to track your progress.
results.emailBody: Enter your email to receive a copy of your detailed results and personalized recommendations.
results.emailOptIn: Subscribe to Issara Institute updates and resources

messages.excellent: Excellent. Your grievance mechanisms are leading practice.
messages.great: Great work! Strong grievance mechanisms with room to excel
messages.solid: Solid foundation. A few sections where targeted improvements will move the needle.
messages.grow: Plenty of room to grow. Start with the lowest-scoring sections - they offer the biggest return.

responsibleProcurement.subtitle: Suppliers and recruitment agencies have a voice! Anonymous feedback helps cascade responsible procurement, more ethical recruitment, and equity in supply chains
responsibleProcurement.intro: All feedback is anonymous, though must be tied to a purchase order or management services contract for validation. Scores, both positive and negative, will contribute to the overall score of the company you are providing feedback on. By giving weight to the voice to the suppliers and recruiters in global supply chains regarding the responsible conduct of brands, retailers, and larger producers, we are driving equity and transparency around responsible sourcing - and helping to cascade better buying practices. There are 3 questions.
